context: The user types on a Mac (cmux) over SSH into this host, later also Windows. Command menu: prefix Space opens an overlay listing all prefix commands with their keys; select with Up/Down + Enter or a digit 1-9/0 shown next to each item; Esc or prefix cancels; no key reaches a pane while the menu is open; the menu is IME-neutral (only arrows/Enter/digits/Esc).

Help overlay and footer list the Ctrl forms and the menu; keep all existing behaviour (resize repeat with arrows, direct scroll, mouse, zoom, catch-up, paste rules, mouse-mode lifecycle).
